newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton rates remain erratic.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton rates remain erratic.

text.p: Asking rates remained erratic for raw cotton from most origins on the European market, leaving spinners little incentive to add to their inventories, trade sources said.
Most European markets therefore presented a dull appearance, with enquiry restricted to the testing of prices for the most popular origins.
Central Asian and west African cottons continued to figure most prominently amongst the growths in demand, but the volume of fresh business was probably small.
